title: Move To offers every active term except the source, in page order
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Net 15 is held by at least one customer. Net 50 and the shop's own term {Term-A} are deactivated, every other standard term is active, and the shop's own term {Term-B}, due 10 days after the invoice date, is active. Other shop terms (from other tests) may also be offered.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-06 Old and {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-06 Ten.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 15" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Open the "Move To" dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from Net 15" opens.
  • Step 3: it offers the active terms in the page order: COD first, Due on Receipt second, then the Net terms by days with {Term-B} after Net 7 and before Net 20, then Net 20, Net 30, Net 45, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120, and Credit Hold last. Net 15 (the source), Net 50 and {Term-A} (inactive) are not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R7: “"Move To" offers every active term except the one being moved from, in the S1-R5 order. It is prefilled with the shop's default; while the default is selected, the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." shows below it. When the term being moved from is the default, "Move To" starts empty.”
  • S4-N3: “Inactive terms and Credit Hold are valid sources (Move Customers is how a shop empties a deactivated term). Inactive terms are never offered in "Move To".”
  • S1-R5: “Rows are listed in this order on both tabs: COD; Due on Receipt; every Net term (standard and the shop's own) by number of days, lowest first; every "day of the following month" term by day, lowest first; any other term A to Z; Credit Hold last. Ties sort A to Z by name. The same order is used in every customer and vendor Credit Terms dropdown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Pick another term"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p2-04-pick-another-term.png

The design's own words:

  • “Any active term can be picked. COD is not offered because the customers are already on it.”
  • “"Move To" is prefilled with the default for new customers (Due on Receipt) and lists every active term except the one being moved from.”
